display.purpose: Home hero h1s only, 40–64px; 64px is the site's type ceiling.

headline-sm.purpose: Prose h2s and table group titles, 24–30px.

passage.purpose: Set passages, index names, footer tagline, phone number.

lead.purpose: Standfirst under a heading, slate, max ~42ch.

row.purpose: Condition summaries, self-check text, set list rows.

title-card.purpose: Image-card titles, How far forward? titles, checklist count.

title-sm.purpose: List item titles, step titles, panel heads, library rows.

label.purpose: Buttons and controls; sentence case, never uppercase.

caption.purpose: Audience switch, card meta, legends, footer base, table heads.

micro.purpose: Chapter timecodes and step play pills only.

measure.purpose: Millimetres, timecodes and spec values only.

narrative.overview:
This is the category standard, played straight. It aims for the clinical authority of a premium implant maker and the rendered-product polish of a sleep-tech brand. The ground is white. The device and its animation stills sit on the animation's own porcelain grey, so renders and frames bleed edge to edge with no visible box. A cool mist band carries the quiet sections. One deep night-blue family holds the sleep and airway moments. Graphite ink and slate do the reading work. A single signal blue marks what you can press and draws the airway line.

Type is one family. Geist is large and light for display, with tight tracking, and the same family runs UI and body. Geist Mono shows up only where a number is a measurement, a timecode or a spec value. Structure comes from hairline rules and spec-sheet rows, not from boxes. Cards are image cards with 20px corners, and the whole card is the link. Dr. Droter's lecture slides appear as framed figure plates on a white mat, like specimens. His portrait is a modest framed photograph (20px corners, never wider than 380px), never larger than life. Each page has one authored motion moment. Everything else settles in from an already-visible state on an exponential ease-out, and reduced motion is honoured throughout.

The system rejects the dental-supplier template (stock smiles, tooth icons, teal gradients, icon-card rows) and the AI-editorial look (a cream-and-serif journal with kicker labels over every heading). Scale is calm and clinical: headlines stop well below billboard size, and the man and the device are shown at a modest, legible size, never larger than life.

The review bar and its "Highlight AI text" layer (`src/components/review/**`) are review tooling, not part of this system. Their amber and green highlights, 11–13px labels and small radii must never be copied into a site surface.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, porcelain media fields, mist bands, one night family.
One accent, signal blue, used for interaction and the airway line.
Geist light display (300–350) at tight tracking; Geist Mono only for measurements.
Hairline spec rows and ruled lists instead of boxed cards.
20px image cards, 12px inner frames, pill controls.
Lecture slides as matted figure plates; the device as transparent renders on porcelain.
One authored motion per page, expo ease-out, honest reduced-motion fallback.
Calm clinical scale: display capped at 64px, content at 1200px, portrait at 380px.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal blue means "interactive" or "airway." It never decorates a heading, a number, an icon tile or a background block.

rules.name: The Contextual Ground Rule
rules.body: Sections set a tone (white, mist, porcelain, night), and the tone re-points the contextual roles: background, foreground, secondary foreground, line, strong line, accent text, surface, track and control. Page CSS uses those roles, never raw grounds, so components work on any field.

rules.name: The Porcelain Is the Animation Rule
rules.body: Every still, render and video frame is shown on porcelain (or the transparent render sits on it) so the image edge disappears. Don't place stills on white or mist.

rules.name: The Mono Is a Ruler Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono sets measurements (4 mm, 10–12 mm, 14.6 × 22.0 × 13.8 mm), timecodes and spec values, and nothing else. Approximate figures (≈ 50%, ≈ 5 min) and counts stay in body type.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No headline gets a label above it. Section heads are a title, optionally a lead, and optionally actions. Numerals appear only on real sequences, such as the four protocol phases, the nine IFU steps and Dr. Droter's ordered categories.

rules.name: The Light Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headline sizes stay at 300–350 weight. Weight rises as size falls (450–500 at title), never the reverse.

rules.name: The Calm Clinical Scale Rule
rules.body: Nothing is oversized. Type caps at 64px (home h1), 43px (page h1), 36px (h2), 26px (h3) and 32px (quotes). Content caps at 1200px and section padding at 128px. Dr. Droter's portrait is a framed photograph no wider than 380px, never full-height and never dissolved into the field. The hero device is contained at 560px or less, night-band renders at 480px or less, and the 3D stage at 600px tall. No image is upscaled or shown past half its source width.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Edges are drawn with 1px insets in the current line colour. A shadow is reserved for something that is genuinely on top: a plate, a floating card, a console or a selected thumb.

dos: **Do** put stills, renders and video on `porcelain` so the image edge disappears. Keep renders contained: the hero device at most 560px, night-band renders at most 480px, the 3D stage at most 600px tall.
**Do** set tone per section and use the contextual roles (`--bg`, `--fg`, `--fg-2`, `--line`, `--accent-text`) in page CSS.
**Do** keep display type at 300–350 weight with −0.024 to −0.035em tracking, and inside the caps of the Calm Clinical Scale Rule.
**Do** pick font sizes from the ramp above; a new size is a design-system change, not a local tweak.
**Do** use Geist Mono for millimetres, timecodes and spec values only, with tabular numerals.
**Do** draw structure with hairline rows (a 1px foreground rule on top, `line-strong` between rows) before reaching for a card.
**Do** show Dr. Droter's slides as matted figure plates (white mat, 20px, Plate shadow, click to enlarge).
**Do** give each page one authored motion moment. Otherwise content settles in from 25% opacity and 16px over 0.9–1.1s on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and reduces to 1ms under reduced motion.
**Do** mark off-site links with ↗ and open them in a new tab.
donts: **Don't** put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings, or number things that are not real sequences.
**Don't** build icon-tile card grids. Lists are ruled rows. Cards are image cards with real imagery.
**Don't** use gradient text, teal gradients, tooth icons or stock smiles.
**Don't** use signal blue for decoration, headings, figures or fills other than the primary button and selected and active states.
**Don't** set approximate figures, counts or prose in Geist Mono.
**Don't** use uppercase or tracked-out labels. All UI text is sentence case at negative or zero tracking.
**Don't** write the mist hex directly. Use the token or `tone="mist"`.
**Don't** invent claims, prices, stats or testimonials to fill a layout slot.
**Don't** enlarge the portrait past 380px, run it full-height, or dissolve it into the field.
**Don't** borrow the review bar's highlight colours, sizes or radii for site UI.
